sourceCopy.name: Gomoku
sourceCopy.title: Gomoku Online Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Play Gomoku free on a 15×15 board against a simple local bot or a friend. No download or account; moves stay in your browser.
sourceCopy.intro: Place black and white stones on a 15×15 board. Make five or more in a row horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to win. Play a friend on this device or challenge a basic local opponent.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do you win at Gomoku?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Take turns placing one stone on an empty intersection. The first player to make five or more continuous stones in any direction wins. This version uses freestyle rules: overlines also win.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Can I play Gomoku without downloading anything?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: Yes. The board and local opponent run in this browser. The game is not uploaded or automatically saved.
howTo: Choose play against the computer or a second person on this device.
Select an empty intersection. Black takes the first move.
Connect five or more stones in a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line to win.

fields.accuracyNote: Freestyle Gomoku: five or more continuous stones win. The local opponent uses a small heuristic, not a tournament-strength search. Game state stays in this tab and is cleared on reload.

additionalFaqs.question: Does a line need to be exactly five stones?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. This game uses freestyle rules: five or more consecutive stones in a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal direction wins.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I play Gomoku against the computer?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. The local computer checks immediate wins and blocks, then scores nearby open lines. It is a simple opponent, not an advanced or tournament-strength AI.

additionalFaqs.question: Does Gomoku work with two players?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. Choose the two-player mode to take turns on the same device. There is no online multiplayer or automatic game saving.
